Delete your iMyCard data

iMyCard does not ask you to create an account, so there is no account to delete.

Data held on your device

Everything the app saves is stored on your device. Deleting the app removes it. You can also clear it from inside the app, or through your device settings, without uninstalling.

Anything else

If you believe we hold data about you and you want it removed, email contact@americangroup.ai and say which app you are writing about. We answer within 30 days.
